decisions.reason: As a flagship service close to the firm's core and publicly committed, escalation of commitment makes withdrawal very unlikely.
Though less visibly central, the firm has invested resources and is responsible, so it tends to persist unless results clearly disappoint.
Presented as a flagship and focus of the firm's direction, high visible commitment and sunk costs lead management to keep it despite lower proximity to the original core.
Building on established offers with incurred investments favors persistence, but its lower centrality creates somewhat higher drop risk.
